title: Cub Scout requirement areas
description: The six areas a Cub Scout rank's required adventures cover, one adventure each. Every rank fills all six, so the set is the same at every rank while the adventure filling it differs — Citizenship is 'King of the Jungle' for a Lion and 'Council Fire' for a Wolf. Single-valued on adventure.area, and null for electives, which fill no area. Beware that two Arrow of Light adventures are *named* after areas ('Personal Fitness', 'Citizenship'): match on adventure ids, never on labels.

terms.label: Character & Leadership
terms.description: Filled by the rank's Bobcat adventure — the Scout Oath and Law, the den's code of conduct, and youth protection. Designed to be completed first.

terms.label: Personal Fitness
terms.description: Physical activity, healthy habits, nutrition and sleep.

terms.label: Personal Safety
terms.description: Recognizing and responding to danger, first aid, and staying safe with others.

terms.label: Family & Reverence
terms.description: Duty to God and family, done with a parent or legal guardian rather than the den.

terms.label: Citizenship
terms.description: Duty to country, community service, flag etiquette and local government.

terms.label: Outdoors
terms.description: Hiking, camping, the Outdoor Code and Leave No Trace Principles for Kids.
